usage: wtune run [-h] [--nodes NODES] [--nx NX] [--ny NY] [--numtiles NUMTILES] [--omp OMP]
                 [--wall-limit WALL_LIMIT] [--segment-minutes SEGMENT_MINUTES] [--stop-at STOP_AT]
                 [--prediction PREDICTION] [--tune-report TUNE_REPORT] [--restart-io-form {14,2}]
                 [--io {adios2,netcdf}] [--cfl-rescue] [--resume N] [--checkpoint-minutes M]
                 [--sidecar] [--wrfda-forecast-only] [--out OUT] [--project PROJECT] [--dry-run]
                 [--wrf-tree WRF_TREE] [--env-source ENV_SOURCE] [--campaign-dir CAMPAIGN_DIR]
                 [--sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD] [--poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL] [--stall-minutes M]
                 [case_dir]

wtune run -- segmented WRF executor with restart hand-offs (`wtune run`).

positional arguments:
  case_dir              default: the project's case/ (then the newest tune/*/tune_report.json is
                        used unless --tune-report or --nodes is given)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --nodes NODES         required unless --tune-report names a winner layout (flags override it)
  --nx NX
  --ny NY
  --numtiles NUMTILES   default: tune report, else 1
  --omp OMP             default: tune report, else 1
  --wall-limit WALL_LIMIT
                        HH:MM:SS per segment job
  --segment-minutes SEGMENT_MINUTES
  --stop-at STOP_AT     YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS (on a whole time step)
  --prediction PREDICTION
                        pred_rebuild.json (wtune predict-rebuild)
  --tune-report TUNE_REPORT
                        predicted-mode tune_report.json: per segment the lowest-predicted
                        candidate is run
  --restart-io-form {14,2}
  --io {adios2,netcdf}  adios2 (default, 2026-10-03 decision): every stream -- history, restart,
                        input, boundary, aux inputs -- is ADIOS2 (io_form 14); netCDF inputs are
                        converted once into <project>/input/bp/ (no project: OUT/_bp_inputs/) and
                        linked as <name>.bp. netcdf: LEGACY escape hatch -- the case's own
                        io_form_* are kept (restart still per --restart-io-form)
  --cfl-rescue          re-run a CFL/NaN-failed segment once with 0.75 dt (marks PHYSICS-GRAY).
                        This is the ONLY user-pre-authorized exception to decision 0056's
                        advisory-only rule for solution-changing knobs -- without it, a CFL/NaN
                        failure stops and writes advice (recommended time_step + a
                        segment.advice.namelist.input) instead of resubmitting anything.
  --resume N            auto-resume an infrastructure-failed segment job from its latest valid
                        restart, at most N times per run (default 1; 0 disables)
  --checkpoint-minutes M
                        restart every M model minutes for --resume, when the case's own
                        restart_interval puts none inside a segment. Default auto: the smallest
                        multiple of the input record step >= run length / 8 (only with --resume >
                        0); 0 writes none
  --sidecar             while a segment job runs, record each valid restart and convert finished
                        history frames to netCDF in the `wtune post` cache, on the job's idle
                        cores
  --wrfda-forecast-only
                        acknowledge that this WRFDA case is run as wrf.exe forecast segments only:
                        WTune does NOT run DA cycles (obsproc/da_wrfvar/da_update_bc). Without it,
                        a WRFDA case is refused.
  --out OUT             required unless --project (or $WTUNE_PROJECT / a project.yaml above cwd)
                        resolves, in which case it defaults to <project>/runs/<id>/ (decision
                        0058)
  --project PROJECT     project dir (decision 0058) -- see --out
  --dry-run
  --wrf-tree WRF_TREE   default $WRF_TREE (run/ files are linked by the job too)
  --env-source ENV_SOURCE
  --campaign-dir CAMPAIGN_DIR
  --sacct-cmd SACCT_CMD
  --poll-interval POLL_INTERVAL
  --stall-minutes M     cancel a running segment job whose rsl.error.0000 has not changed for M
                        minutes and stop the run (0 disables; default 20)
